entries.title: Make timelapses easily using FFmpeg
entries.author: indiantinker
entries.excerpt: I make a lot of Timelapse and have tried a lot of ways to make Timelapses using python etc, today I found the easiest one using FFMpeg :) ffmpeg -framerate 30 -pattern_type glob -i '*.JPG' -c:v libx264 -r 30 -pix_fmt yuv420p timelapse.mp4
entries.guide_zh: 作者分享使用 FFmpeg 制作延时摄影的方法，简化多张照片合成视频的流程。
